final_assessment: Executed the amendments rc02c's system blind pair earned, and recorded the pair's economics. Two re-frames, no new rulings, no ratifications. (1) rc10-apply-closure's charter and (2) Q-crc-12's standing recommendation both instructed a future seam to branch on `budgetExhausted`, which rc02c deletes. Both are RE-FRAMED rather than deleted, and the distinction is the substance: the defect they describe — an archive seam scoped to one gate is silent about every other gate, and a change that never applied still archives past its proposal gate — survives the retirement completely untouched. Only its vocabulary died. The prompt now fires on any gate whose computed state is not a passing one, whatever its `before` phase, and the recorded spend MAY be shown at the seam but SHALL NOT be branched on, per R-crc-11(h). The status log records the pair itself: 8 external and 9 fresh, 2 overlapping, 15 distinct, zero CRITICAL, and a capture-recapture residual near 58% — against rc02's first pair at roughly 60% with zero CRITICAL overlap. Two pairs on different stages months apart agreeing within a couple of points makes the residual a property of the pipeline rather than a bad day, which is the number issue #13 exists to move and is now measured twice. It also records the finding only a reviewer reading the PLAN could make, and the observation behind it: nothing in this repository compares a stage's charter to the engine it will run on, which is Q-crc-14's missing moment observed one layer up at the program layer. rc03a remains quiescent-awaiting-ratification; the offer was surfaced and declined earlier in this same session and was NOT re-fired, which is the no-nagging rule operating and is itself the recurring cost Q-crc-11's counter now records.
